# Synthetics
- All Synthetics must be given a chance to stand down, however [bold]must[/bold] be repaired to serve its sentence if lethal force is used. - All Synthetics are capable of making advanced and critical decisions for [bold]themselves[/bold] based off their surroundings and events, compliant with their programming.
## UNMC Synthetics - UNMC Synthetics are programmed against being able to break Marine Law, and should not be arrested unless the [color=#ffa500][bold]Provost Marshal Office[/bold][/color] has approved their arrest. - These synthetic units are granted the same rights and privileges of regular marines. - If any [color=#ff000d][bold]MP[/bold][/color] believes they have broken Marine Law, a report should be faxed to the [color=#ffa500][bold]Provost Marshal Office[/bold][/color]. - Synthetics not directly part of UNMC do not have the above immunities.
## Third-Party Synthetics - Should be treated as if they are [bold][textlink="recovered personnel" link="RMCMarineSOPNONModThirdparty"][/bold]. - Recovered Colony Synthetics, due to emergency or otherwise severe circumstances, may choose as they wish to align themselves with whoever they wish and provide assistance. Due to this, the [color=#008000][bold]Commander[/bold][/color] may request the assistance of recovered Synthetics for the duration of the operation; similar to [bold][textlink="Contracting" link="RMCMarineSOPNONModThirdparty"][/bold]. - They may have their arrest ordered by the [color=#008000][bold]Commander[/bold][/color] or [color=#8B0000][bold]Chief MP[/bold][/color] without the need to provide a report to the [color=#ffa500][bold]Provost Marshal Office[/bold][/color]. - Any of these synthetics that act against the UNMC; such as taking [italic]valuable[/italic] supplies without request, or destroying property and defenses, may be declared rogue by [bold]either[/bold] the [color=#008000][bold]Commander[/bold][/color] or [color=#8B0000][bold]Chief MP[/bold][/color], where the [color=#008000][bold]Commander[/bold][/color] takes priority. Synthetics should receive a warning before being declared rogue, unless not viable or actively detrimental to the lives of others. - When declared rogue, the synthetic loses any protections and lethal force may be used freely. Once resolved, their rogue status should be lifted by the [color=#008000][bold]Commander[/bold][/color] or [color=#8B0000][bold]Chief MP[/bold][/color].
